semantic_insights: The supplied scope selects exactly the complete root datasheet. Component file collections were used as evidence within that root and were not scored as separate units.
Empty caller applicability context leaves all conditional predicates unknown. All 50 items remain scored, with no exclusions.
The record carefully distinguishes pediatric-release facts from adult-project descriptions, project-wide investigator roles and PhysioNet platform attribution.

Explicit root-level prose supplies platform identity, version changes, raw-source provenance and scoped BIDS conformance. These were credited without asserting broader conformance or moving component values into the root.
